description:
[DESTRUCTIVE] DESTRUCTIVE: removes ONE dead connection (by account id) from the brand, leaving the brand's other accounts on that platform alone. Call it with dryRun=true first and show the user the result. It never cancels anything: if posts, review holds, queue items or shares are still on the account it refuses with the counts (409); a healthy connected account is refused too (the user disconnects it on the Connect page). Confirm with the user first.
(Wraps DELETE /api/v2/accounts/{id}.)

brandId.description: The brand the connection belongs to, as for GET /api/v2/accounts.

dryRun.description: true → only report what is pinned and whether it could be removed; nothing is written.

id.description: An account id (as GET /api/v2/accounts shows), or the connection row id when several connections carry the same account id.

name: account_remove
title: Remove one dead connection
